chapter-stp.mechanism: a riveted steel hull plate with one clean welded seam running across it, photographed raking, as a halftone photograph band across the lower half
chapter-stp.chosen_rationale: Best of twelve by measurement, not by eye. A reviewer said the two arcs on the shipped plate do not share a centre, and measurement agreed with the reviewer and not with the rationale that used to sit here. scripts/whitepaper-plates/score_broken_arc.py fits a circle to each arc's outer boundary: this candidate's halves are 6.3% of a radius from concentric with radii 11.5% apart, where the other eleven are 92% to 637% from concentric -- they are two unrelated shapes, not one interrupted ring. So this is the plate that comes closest to the brief, and it is close rather than exact: at page size the eye reads one broken band, and a caliper would not.

frontispiece.note: Swiss frontispiece: the Leviathan rebuilt as International Typographic Style. Variants a and b read as a friendly toy robot -- small in its field, rounded, primary-coloured -- and were rejected; c is monumental and cropped by the frame, near monochrome, with the searchlight as one hard ochre diagonal and a single red square.
